data.provider: The Odds API historical event odds (paid plans; player props available after 2023-05-03T05:30:00Z, 5-minute snapshots)
data.snapshot: Latest snapshot at or before tipoff minus 60 minutes; snapshot timestamp and market last_update must both be strictly before tipoff.
data.holdout: 2025-26 regular season, games where both teams have played at most 10 regular-season games before tipoff.
data.development: Optional 2024-25 equivalent window; any threshold tuning happens only on development data.

leakageRules: V2 inputs use ESPN regular-season game logs dated strictly before tipoff (prior season plus current-season games already played).
Outcomes come only from the target game's final box score; they are never available to the model or the selection rule.
Players with under 5 minutes in the target game are void (props void on DNP), counted and reported separately.
Thresholds and selection rule are fixed in this file; the holdout is evaluated once per registered version.

selectionRule.onePerPlayerMarketGame: Highest-EV side/book per player, market and game; never both sides.

publicationCriteria.roiUncertainty: Game-clustered bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, 95% interval on flat-stake ROI.
publicationCriteria.calibrationSample: All two-sided priced candidates at real lines (not only selected bets).

outcome: V2 publishable may only be proposed if every criterion passes; failure keeps publishable=false.
